predictor_missingness: Common finite observed/model Q eligibility; retain missing predictor values for XGBoost native missing-value handling identically across arms. Unknown verification quality is not coded clean or bad.
temporal_split: Train 2018-2019; tune on 2020; test 2021; valid January observations retained.
spatial_split: All Wurm gauges and all Ahr/Erft/Sieg external records excluded from every fit/tuning fold. Four deterministic topology-group inner folds, shared across arms/policies.
population: Full eligible donor/local training census, full eligible Wurm and external 2021 test census. No event sample; report external and local results separately.
primary_selection: Reconstructed-discharge RMSE in mm/day; aggregate inner MSE in proportion to contributing river-group counts, then square root.
calibration: Local FDC uses extra held-local past clean labels, labelled separately. Donor FDC uses the same finite historical donor labels allowed for the learner; unknown provider QA remains explicit.
scope: Step 1 only: one uniform fixed 3000-tree capacity check, same validation/test populations and settings. No automatic further cap increase or multi-year launch.
reuse_policy: Reuse early-stopped old tuning fits only after source/runtime verification and a fresh 3000-tree parity-control fit. If control differs, refit every tuning job with the new maximum. Capped fits refit from scratch. Refit final ensembles only if parameters/tree count change.
